Q183.reason: Trespass by a chattel needs intent or negligence, and the homeowner had no reason to know of the undiscoverable switch defect, so he is not liable.

Q184.reason: The clerk is disinterested, so the Dead Man's Statute does not apply, but his account of the content of the signed register is secondary evidence of a writing the court should require to be produced.

Q185.reason: Under UCC 2-209(3), the modified contract ($3,200) is still over $500, so the oral modification must meet the statute of frauds and does not.
